text:
mike: heads up — observed p95 spike on hopper canary for mid-length requests (~1k-2k tokens). was stable yesterday but today a subset of requests jumped ~40% latency :eyes:
perf-bot: automated alert: cluster=hopper-canary pool=h100-midseq metric=p95_latency baseline=28ms current=39ms delta=+39% link=https://perf.internal/reports/2488
priya: repro steps? distribution? can run local perf driver against same snapshot
mike: repro pattern: short-prefill + long decode continuation around 1200 tokens. KV cache warmed but kernel picker chooses split_attn path causing extra memcpy + two kernel launches. rough profile pasted below:
```
Profile: batch=8 seq=1400
tokens/sec: baseline=480 -> observed=300
time breakdown (median): prefill_k=11ms, decode_k=22ms, memcpy=8ms, kernel_launch=5ms
dominant kernel: split_attn_v2 (vs fused_attn on older runs)
```
zack: hmmm — selector heuristic currently thresholds on declared prefill_len and raw_seq_len. it doesn't account for effective_kv_active ratio (i.e., whether most cache reads hit). that can flip preference at midseq even when fused would be cheaper
priya: can we add a microprobe at request start: run a tiny warmup kernel to estimate kv_hit_rate and factor that into selector? cheap probe like run 1-step KV lookup and measure hit%
sara: i'd prefer a config-first mitigation: add a gating rule to prefer fused_attn when seq in [800,2000] and batch_size >= 4 until we have a robust estimator. easier to canary as a rollout flag
zack: agreed, quick gate + longer-term probe. prototype selector change (pseudo-config):
```
kernel_selector:
  heuristics:
    - name: midseq_fused_gate
      when:
        seq_range: [800,2000]
        batch_min: 4
      prefer: fused_attn
      rollout_flag: feature/selector-midseq-gate
```
mike: can we also log sampled kernel decision reasons to tracing so we can verify? include fields: chosen_kernel, reason_code, kv_hit_est, seq_len, batch_size
perf-bot: tracing hook added to dev cluster (not prod) at 2488000001 by infra. sample_rate=1%
priya: i'll run a targeted sweep on hopper-canary with batch sizes [1,4,8] and seqs [600,900,1200,1600,2200] and post metrics. command i'll use:
```
./tools/perf-run --cluster hopper-canary --model gpt-like --batch-sizes 1,4,8 --seqs 600,900,1200,1600,2200 --samples 200
```
zack: i'll open the selector PR with gate + added trace keys. will include unit test for heuristic ordering and a small microprobe stub (disabled by default). draft PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/+/PR-8123 (WIP) :pencil2:
sara: assign rollout to me. once PR merged let's flip rollout_flag to 5% then 25% then 100% if stable. create a dashboard: please include p95, p99, tokens/sec, and kernel_switch_rate
mike: thanks. priority: reduce p95 regression - if probe/gate doesn't fix, fallback is to force fused on canary until we root-cause deeper kernel perf regression.
priya: starting runs now, will post first 30-min snapshot in this thread. :rocket:
